Model slug → live session promise; sessions are created at most once.

defaultOrtLoader

Default ORT loader — dynamic-imports the jsep bundle (webgpu + webnn + wasm EPs). Vite code-splits it into a lazy chunk; the specifier is a token-level constant for jest module mocking.

  • @returns The onnxruntime-web module namespace.

mlTierAllowed

Modern-tier gate — ML inference is a progressive enhancement reserved for es2025+ bundles. The loader stamps window.__LK_TIER with the picked tier name ('esnext' always qualifies; es<year> qualifies at ML.MIN_ES_TIER and up). When the stamp is absent (dev server, prerender, tests) ML stays allowed — the EP capability probes remain the real gate. A stamped older tier returns false so the ~1MB ORT chunk is never fetched and callers keep their heuristic paths with zero polyfills.

  • @returns true when ML inference may run on this browser tier.

ensureOrt

Lazily imports and configures the ORT runtime — wasm binary paths, single wasm thread (the models are tiny; the proxy worker isn't worth a thread slot), and warning-level logging. Concurrent callers share the first attempt; a rejected load clears the latch so a transient failure doesn't permanently disable ML for the session.

  • @param loadModule Injectable loader — tests substitute a stub module.
  • @returns The configured ORT module, or null when unavailable.

executionProviders

Builds the execution-provider list for this device: webnn only when navigator.ml exists, webgpu only when navigator.gpu exists, and wasm always last so an unsupported accelerator can't block a session.

  • @returns EP names in preference order.

mlSession

Creates (and caches) the InferenceSession for a model slug. First tries the full EP chain; if the accelerator session throws (e.g. a WebNN driver rejects the graph) it retries wasm-only before giving up — a broken NPU path must not take the model down with it.

  • @param slug Model slug from ML.MODEL_* — resolves to /models/<slug>.onnx.
  • @param loadModule Injectable ORT loader (forwarded to ensureOrt).
  • @returns The session, or null when every EP failed.

runMlModel

Runs one inference pass: wraps each feed in an ORT tensor, executes the session, and unwraps the outputs into plain Float32Arrays.

  • @param slug Model slug — session is lazily created on first use.
  • @param feeds Input-name → {data,dims} map.
  • @param loadModule Injectable ORT loader — tests substitute a stub.
  • @returns Output-name → Float32Array, or null on any failure.

resetMlEngine

Test/HMR teardown — drops cached sessions and the module latch so a fresh realm re-probes hardware instead of inheriting stale sessions.
